technical_data.url_obfuscation: The URL uses a JWT token in the query string to appear legitimate and bypass link scanners. The domain name uses homoglyph 'o' replaced with '0' in screenshots (fraudulentd0main.com).

indicators.recent_domain_registration: fraudulentdomain.com created just 1 week before email received

examples.detection_method: Email gateway advanced threat protection flagged DKIM and DMARC failures, detected macro-enabled PDF attachment, and anomalous Reply-To header. User reported suspicious wire transfer request prompting SOC review of SMTP logs and domain registration. IOC matching of domain fraudulentdomain.com triggered threat intel alerts.

examples.detection_method: Email security gateway detected SPF and DMARC failures. URL analysis sandboxing flagged bit.ly link redirecting to credential harvesting site. User reported suspicious email which triggered domain and URL reputation checks. Network proxy logs confirmed access to maliciousdomain.net at time of phishing attempt.
